title: Services — Supreme Art
description: Printed packaging for tablets, capsules, syrups and food products, plus pharmaceutical leaflets and product labels.

range.heading: Packaging for pharmaceutical and food products.
range.lead: From medicine cartons to food packs, leaflets and labels, we print and finish every product to your artwork, dimensions and required specification.

items.title: Tablet packaging
items.text: Printed cartons made to fit tablet blister and strip packs, with accurate dimensions and clear product information.

items.title: Capsule packaging
items.text: Precisely produced cartons for capsule blister, strip and bottle formats in a range of pack sizes.

items.title: Syrup packaging
items.text: Protective bottle cartons for syrups and liquid medicines, with partitions or inserts where required.

items.title: Leaflets & inserts
items.text: Printed and folded information leaflets and package inserts prepared to fit inside the finished pack.

items.title: Labels
items.text: Clear, colour-accurate printed labels for bottles, products and outer packaging.

items.title: Food packaging
items.text: Printed folding cartons and pouches for food products, including masala packaging produced for Stanley Foods and SwaaD Foods.
items.alt: Supreme Art masala and food packaging

food.alt: Supreme Art masala and food packaging

finishes.heading: Finishes
finishes.text: A variety of finishing methods can elevate your packaging from good to exceptional. We provide a range of surface treatments and finishes, applied in-house after printing, to protect the carton, lift the artwork and make it harder to copy.

features.title: Anti-counterfeit packaging
features.text: Security features printed and finished into the carton itself, so they cannot be peeled off and moved to a fake.

photos.alt: Proflox carton with a repeating Ferozsons security pattern embossed over the whole face

features.title: Colour-shifting seal
features.text: An ink that changes colour as the carton is tilted: a quick check of authenticity that an ordinary printer cannot reproduce.

photos.alt: Icon carton with a colour-shifting Ferozsons seal on a metallised face

features.title: Lamination
features.text: A thin film bonded over the printed board, in gloss or matte, for a tougher surface that resists scuffs and moisture.

photos.alt: TUFF injection carton with a laminated finish

features.title: Food-grade coatings (water base)
features.text: Water-base, low-migration coatings safe for packaging that touches food or medicine, with a clean, bright gloss.

photos.alt: Esomega carton finished with a water-base food-grade coating

features.title: Drip-off coatings
features.text: Matte and gloss on one sheet: the gloss stands out in relief against a matte ground, without a second pass.

photos.alt: Imo carton standing on end, its gloss swirls raised against a matte ground
Imo carton lying flat, showing the drip-off gloss pattern
Vazkor and Imo cartons side by side with drip-off gloss highlights

features.title: Thermal foiling
features.text: Metallic foil fused to the board with heat for logos, borders and highlights.

features.title: Hot stamping (foiling)
features.text: A heated die presses metallic or holographic foil into the board for a crisp, raised finish that doubles as a security layer.

photos.alt: Duet carton with hot-stamped metallic blue lettering
Vosun-D and Duet cartons with gold and blue hot-stamped foil

features.title: UV and spot UV
features.text: A clear UV gloss over the whole sheet to deepen the colours and protect the print, or on chosen areas only for a raised, textured accent.

photos.alt: Zeflox carton with a full UV gloss and raised spot-UV lettering
Efloxin carton with a spot-UV Herbion pattern over the print

cta.heading: Need a specific carton?
cta.text: Send us your artwork or dieline and we'll come back with a quote and a timeline.
